model: frozen V8 stochastic Laplacian residual plus a separately learned deterministic zero-DC low-pass residual mean
lowpass_target: truth - frozen deterministic mean - sigma2 Laplacian residual, followed by exact cube-mean projection

lowpass_model.loss: 50 percent uniform MSE plus 50 percent train-only density-tail-balanced MSE

development_rule: Full ensemble16/40 gate on TNG and SIMBA development; select the smallest step passing all eight checks in both domains

independence.eagle_opening: only after development and historical SIMBA stress pass
